invoices_paid_confirmed.name: invoices_paid_confirmed
invoices_paid_confirmed.value: "invoices"."status" <> 'paid' OR ("invoices"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL)

invoices_period_order.name: invoices_period_order
invoices_period_order.value: "invoices"."period_start" IS NULL OR ("invoices"."period_end" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."period_end" > "invoices"."period_start")
